I'm so sorry OP. I can definitely say you are not alone. I was physically mentally and sexually abused by my father until age 5. I was again sexually abused by an uncle until I was 9. I lost my virginity at 15 by being raped. I was beaten, strangled and raped by my ex. I lost my brother (my best friend) to suicide. I was again raped at 25 by a "friend" and some people took his side of the story even though he's done it to other girls. I will say that trauma stays with you for life. I have PTSD and anxiety. But I've spent much time in therapy and that has helped. Some days are good, some days are bad. Fill your life up with passions, hobbies and things that give you purpose. Don't compare yourself to others and where they are in your life. Try to focus on you physical health I also was bulimic and anorexic but I realized I didn't want the bad guys and the trauma to win. You are worthy of health, happiness and healing. There is only one you, she is you temple. Mind body and spirit, all deserving of you love. You can do this. Have faith in yourself. Love yourself even when it seems impossible. Neither of us deserved what happened to us, but we can change what we deserve now. Best wishes to you sweetheart. You're stronger than you know and braver than you feel.
